That full scope-specific inventory remains unapproved. All original text is identical to the earlier packet. Reread/reconciled all complete actor contexts, every own-term lead including alternate formatting, earlier chain, missing/conflicts and machine search scopes. Machine missing target provision not located EO:14096 is resolved substantively by reading its newly supplied complete actor context, especially section 5(c). The automatic missing list is not treated as proof the text is absent. EO:14096 section 5(c) directs agencies conducting research/data collection under the environmental-justice orders to comply with applicable human-subject ethics standards, citing EO:12975 as an example. It does not expressly amend, extend or reestablish NBAC or reverse the 2003 revocation. It is a later research-context command and reference, not proof of completion of original 1995 review/report commands. EO:13316 section 3 revokes this full named order effective September 30, 2003 under section 6; the later formal revocation does not prove the earlier trigger. Generic reference exclusion counts changed without supplying an additional located terminating actor. No provisional status or current predicate is altered. No deadline is accepted as an end.
